name: tofino-like
description: A Tofino-like switch: Model A (Franco et al. 2024) for the ingress pipeline, Model B (DPTP, SOSR 2019) for MAC receive and egress. Means only; see doc/latency-model.md.

franco_linear.source: Franco et al., A comprehensive latency profiling study of the Tofino P4 programmable ASIC-based hardware, Computer Communications 218 (2024) 14-30, Table 2 and the generalized formula of the appendix. APS BF2556X-1T, TNA, ingress pipeline T1 to T2, mean latency in ns.

mac_rx_delay_ns.source: DPTP (Kannan, Joshi, Chan, SOSR 2019), Table 1, MAC & Parser Delay at Client (MacD), idle links, 10G: from the end of the packet at the Rx MAC to the ingress pipeline

egress_delay_ns.source: DPTP (SOSR 2019), Table 1, Request Egress Tx Delay (ReqTx), idle links, 10G: egress pipeline, deparser and Tx MAC, up to the start of serialization (section 3.1, Measuring ReqTx and RespTx)

notes: Models A and B come from different switches, port speeds and probe packets. DPTP's Q segment (about 307 ns) already contains the ingress pipeline, so it is not used; the time from the ingress pipeline into the queue (T2) has no value here.

The DPTP values are means at 10G; at other port speeds the switch warns. Wire delay (DPTP: about 70 ns over 1 m of DAC, serialization of the 60-byte probe included) is the channel's Delay plus its serialization in the simulator.
fcs_check: assumed, not verified. control_plane_update_delay_ns: no published value for Tofino; set the device attribute ControlPlaneDelay.
Forwarding mode of the measured switches: not stated by either paper; store-and-forward here.
